title: Chapter 276: This Is What The Grassroots Want
content:
Chapter 276: This Is What The Grassroots Want

The battle inside the blood mist was so miserable that it couldn't be more miserable, and it shocked the more than 5,000 second-rate and below experts who were waiting outside to watch the battle.

My God, there are so many first-class people, hundreds of them, and in just half an hour, there are only four or five people left, and all of them are injured, looking like they are about to die at any time.

The fall of such a large-scale master undoubtedly shocked everyone's minds. Originally, they worked hard all their lives, but what they wanted was to reach the first-class state, and it was not even certain whether they could achieve it.

But now, first-class masters are like ants on the side of the road, being chased to death at will. Their lives are just like ordinary people, so fragile and vulnerable.

This undoubtedly shook their faith, made them doubt their own cultivation, and were full of confusion about their future.

However, these fluctuations were only for a while after all, or there were greater interests, which made them ignore these.

"Let's go together, there are only four or five of these grandmasters left, and they are all wounded. This is a god-sent opportunity. I will recover this precious sword after losing it. It's a great opportunity!" Among the crowd, such a sound suddenly sounded, causing everyone's eyes to roll, staring at the five people who survived.

However, even though many people were in the mood to be provoked by this sound.

But there were also some people who didn't obey, instead they pushed through the crowd and came to the remaining five grandmasters. A small circle was formed between them and the crowd outside, watching out for those low-strength people on the periphery.

"You jackals, you want to take a step forward and pass our level first!" said a man who looked like a leader among the people in the middle of the crowd.

The crowd who stepped forward to protect the five masters, wearing these five different costumes, were clearly divided into five factions.

Obviously, these are the disciples of these five masters.

"Master, don't worry, some people are just waiting for someone to be there, and we will not let these young people take a step forward!" The man said to the surrounding crowd, then turned his head to the white-haired old man behind him, and said while patting his chest.

"Well, be careful!" The white-haired old man's face was full of relief, and his pale face seemed to be a little rosy again because of his disciple's performance.

"You villains, this sword has no owner, it is something that everyone can get, and now you want to claim it alone, let's go through our barrier first!" Outside there was a big man with a beard full of indignation, his eyes were full of anger , said righteously.

Afterwards, without saying much, the big man directly raised the huge ax behind his back, waved the huge ax with both hands, shouted, and went straight to the defensive circle formed by the disciples in front of him, and killed him.

"Kill, everyone will follow along. They only have more than three hundred people. Are we four or five thousand people still afraid of their small number of people? People will laugh at them if they spread the word!"

Behind the big man, there were forty or fifty people rushing up with him, and some of them shouted loudly.

Behind these people, the hesitant crowd immediately let go of their hesitation and followed after hearing the words of these people, their fearless bodies, and the fear on the faces of the so-called people in front of them.

...

Liaodong County, Liaoyang City.

Today's Liaoyang, since it was occupied by Yuguo, the capital of Yuguo moved from Changchun City to this city closer to the Seven Kingdoms in the south. It has been three years since now.

In three years, because it is the capital of a country and the center of the whole country, it developed extremely quickly. In a short period of time, Liaoyang City has changed from its original circumference of four or five miles to the current big city with a circumference of thirty miles. The population has also increased from the original 5,000 to 200,000 today, and it can be said to be the most powerful city in the Northland.

The imperial palace in Liaoyang City has now returned to Yuguo, and Zhong Yu, who has started to deal with many major affairs of Yuguo with peace of mind, was originally so busy that he had no time to spare.

But now, for the first time ever, he spared some time to meet an unknown little person.

In the majestic hall, Zhong Yu sat on the emperor's throne, from top to bottom, looking down like an ant from a high place, looking down at the man who was throwing his five bodies to the ground below, worshiping her with the most respectful etiquette

"So, Qing is the warrior who retrieved the sword for me, so brave!" Zhong Yu looked down playfully, at the man who was trembling all over, with a respectful face, who didn't even dare to look at him.

It was unexpected.

With Zhong Yu's identity, few people can arouse his interest like this, even if this person helped him find the sword, it shouldn't be so.

And there is only one reason for all this, the man below has a great name, Liu Bang.

Today's Liu Bang, he has joined the peasant family, but his status is not as respected as after the plot of Qin Shimingyue, he is just a senior leader.

Although Liu Bang's status in the farming family is high, there are hundreds of ordinary leaders like him in the farming family, and Liu Bang is not outstanding among them, just in the middle.

Since Zhong Yu got the news, found his sword, ate its bait, and the final winner was called Liu Bang, he sent his own spies to find out about Liu Bang.

The information he got as a result surprised him.

Although Liu Bang today is not as full of talents as when Chu and Han were fighting for hegemony later, his subordinates are also full-fledged and have many talented people to help.

For example, Fan Kuai, Zhou Bo, Cao Shen, Xia Houying and others who started with him in Pei County and helped him conquer the world, have gathered under his command at this moment and become his capable generals.

As for people like Xiao He who have some identities and serve as some low-level officials in Chu State, although they did not directly join Liu Bang, they maintained a very good relationship with each other and had constant entanglements.

This can't help but make him sigh, he is worthy of being the proud son of the world, even if Qin Shimingyue's protagonist is not him at first, but Liu Bang also has great luck, even if he has no knowledge, he can't hide his sharpness.

"Caomin is a mean villain who dare not be called a warrior. To see His Majesty's beauty is already a blessing for all ages. I am terrified!" Liu Banggong replied, his tone was full of caution and respect.

"Hehe, you don't have to be like this. Since you have taken back the long sword, then I will not go back on the original promise." Zhong Yu chuckled a few times, looking at the original founding emperor of the Han Dynasty, panicked in front of him, It is quite interesting to be cautious and cautious, for fear of causing death if you are not careful. It can be regarded as a little adjustment for his boring life!

When Liu Bang heard the words, his face was still terrified, but he couldn't help secretly rejoicing in his heart. He worked so hard for it, isn't it just such a sentence?
